nina: Heads-up: a user reported our JS SDK sample app started failing in the edge preview after yesterday's package.json changes that tightened the `exports` map. Error in CI: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token 'export'` during startup.

raj: Ok, that screams a CJS consumer ended up loading an .mjs file. Did we remove the root entry or `main` fallback when we added the conditional exports? paste the package.json.

nina: snippet: `{"name":"@redwood/sdk-example","version":"0.4.0","exports":{"./sub":{"import":"./dist/sub.mjs","require":"./dist/sub.cjs"}},"types":"dist/index.d.ts"}`

leo: Two things: 1) no root (".") export so consumers doing `require('@redwood/sdk-example')` or bundlers that expect a root entry may resolve differently; 2) no `./package.json` export — some packagers and pnpm/yalc workflows try to read package.json via the exports map and failover. Edge runtimes + bun are stricter about resolution semantics and will prefer the `import` path in ambiguous cases.

raj: Also watch for monorepo/pnpm behaviour: `pnpm` with nodeLinker=hoisted or 'node-modules' can end up reading package.json differently, and TypeScript's `moduleResolution: node16`/`nodenext` can change what path tsc emits. If someone does `require('@redwood/sdk-example/sub')` a non-exhaustive exports map can resolve to the `.mjs`.

nina: Repro: sample-app CI edge-preview image fails; local Node 16.20 passed because Node's resolution differs from edge runtime. CI: `ci-bot` reports sample-app matrix (node16/edge) 3/3 failed.

ci-bot: CI failure: https://ci.internal/99999 — sample-app integration failed on edge-worker.

leo: Quick mitigation: add explicit root export and `./package.json` export, and keep `main`/`module` top-level fallbacks for older tooling. Example exports block: {".":{"import":"./dist/index.mjs","require":"./dist/index.cjs"},"./package.json":"./package.json","./sub":{"import":"./dist/sub.mjs","require":"./dist/sub.cjs"}} and add "main":"dist/index.cjs","module":"dist/index.mjs".

raj: For types, consider `typesVersions` if we ship ESM-only subpath typings or include companion `.d.ts` next to each compiled artifact. Right now `"types":"dist/index.d.ts"` is okay for root but subpath imports may need `dist/sub.d.ts` present. Also include `exports` entries for types by placing `.d.ts` next to the corresponding `.cjs`/`.mjs` files.

nina: I'll open a small patch that: 1) adds root export + `./package.json` export, 2) restores main/module, 3) ensures npm pack includes dist/*.{cjs,mjs,d.ts}. I'll publish a canary and run `npm pack`/install in the sample-app and rerun edge-preview.

leo: Also add a tiny smoke test to CI that installs the `npm pack` tarball into the sample-app and runs both a `require()`-based and `import()`-based runner. Include esbuild/rollup quick-bundles to catch bundler edge cases.

raj: Long-term: add a devex checklist for exports changes: test across Node 12/14/16/18 (CJS and ESM), Bun, edge runtimes, pnpm workspace install, and `npm pack` validation. Update our CHANGELOG and onboarding docs to show both `import` and `require` examples and mention known monorepo caveats.

doc-bot: Note created: devex/exports-change-checklist.md (internal).

nina: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/720 — includes fallbacks and smoke tests. I'll report back with CI status here. Thanks! :+1:
